samples.question: This picture contains two rails of small square pads that lie far apart: one upright rail of nine pads stacked near a left or right margin, and one flat rail of nine pads in a row near the top or bottom margin. Every pad is a square block of exactly one of two tones, dark or pale, and both tones appear inside both rails. A few small clutter marks - narrow bars and diamonds, none of them square pads and none of them on a rail - are scattered on the background and carry no evidence. Exactly three pads of the upright rail are dark and exactly three pads of the flat rail are dark, whatever the answer is. Carry out this operation. Number the upright rail's pads 1 to 9 from top to bottom and the flat rail's pads 1 to 9 from left to right. Now take an empty nine-row, nine-column field and mark every cell whose row number is a dark pad of the upright rail and whose column number is a dark pad of the flat rail; mark no other cell. Exactly nine cells get marked in every picture. The marked cells always form exactly one of four figures. 'solid_block' is one solid three-by-three square of nine touching cells. 'dot_lattice' is nine separated single cells in a widely spaced three-by-three arrangement, no two of them touching. 'upright_bars' is three separated upright bars, each one cell wide and three cells tall. 'flat_bars' is three separated flat bars, each three cells wide and one cell tall. The figure is drawn nowhere in the picture. Neither rail settles the answer on its own: the upright rail alone leaves two figures possible and the flat rail alone leaves the other pairing, so both distant rails must be read and combined. Which figure do the marked cells form? Answer with exactly one of: solid_block, dot_lattice, upright_bars, flat_bars.
